title_en: 2027 German Government (DAAD) Summer Course Scholarship: Call for Applications
summary: Undergraduate and master's students with German language proficiency at level B1 or above may apply for the 2027 German Government (DAAD) Summer Course Scholarship. translation:
2027 German Government (DAAD) Summer Course Scholarship: Call for Applications

Scholars for the 2027 German Government Summer Course will be selected as follows.

A. Eligibility: Undergraduate and master's students with German language proficiency at level B1 or above.
* Any major is eligible. At the time the scholarship is received, the applicant must have completed at least the second year of bachelor's studies and must be enrolled at a university.

B. Application deadline: 30 October 2026 (once a year).

C. Application method: Online application.

D. Scholarship benefits: Language course tuition fees, accommodation, a one-time allowance (475 euros), travel costs (1,735 euros), and health insurance, accident insurance and personal liability insurance, among others.

E. Scholarship period: Generally four weeks (between June and September 2027).

F. Contact: DAAD Korea office (주한독일고등교육진흥원). The telephone number and email address are given in the original notice.
※ For other details, please refer to the website (www.daad-korea.org) and the <Attachment>.
